projects.title: Short Public Text Classification
bullets: Cleaned public question-category text records using Python and pandas for short-document classification in a supervised undergraduate independent study.
Compared classification errors across document lengths using scikit-learn and documented the train and test splits.

projects.title: Public Bibliographic Database Queries
bullets: Loaded public bibliographic tables into a SQLite relational database using Python as part of a supervised undergraduate course project.
Wrote SQL aggregation and join queries for the course project's investigation of query performance on public tabular data.
